title: In This World You See How Many Times You'll Meet Someone
description: A stranger on his train has twelve thousand meetings left with him, so he does the only sensible thing and hides. Who would you hide from? #anime #shorts #animestory #retroanime

characters.Haru: 17-year-old Japanese boy, short black hair with one cowlick sticking up, white short-sleeve summer school shirt, black trousers, white sneakers, navy canvas shoulder bag, no hat
characters.Kana: 17-year-old Japanese girl, shoulder-length chestnut-brown hair with a small yellow hairclip, gray school blazer over a white blouse with a green ribbon, green plaid pleated skirt, navy knee socks, brown loafers, carries a paperback with a plain blue cover and no writing, no hat

scenes.say: In this world, you see how many more times you'll meet someone. Strangers on Haru's train show zero. Then a girl gets on, and above her head glows twelve thousand.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Inside a quiet 1990s Tokyo commuter train car in the morning, Haru stands holding a hand strap; a faint small glowing 0 floats above the heads of two tired office workers near him. [4-7s] At the open doors of the same train car, Kana steps in, one small soft glowing number floating above her head. [7-10s] Close-up of Haru's face in the train car, eyes huge, mouth falling open.

scenes.say: Twelve thousand is one meeting a day for about thirty-three years. Haru has never seen her before. He's seventeen. He's never even held a girl's hand. So he panics and hides.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Inside the morning train car, Haru slowly counts on his fingers, a bead of sweat on his temple. [4-7s] In the same train car, Kana sits by the window, calm, holding up her plain blue paperback. [7-10s] Near the doors of the same train car, Haru squeezes behind a metal pole and peeks out at Kana with one eye.

scenes.say: So he takes an earlier train. She's on it. He tries the bus. She's on it, hiding behind the same paperback. Haru notices she never turns a single page.
scenes.video: [0-4s] On an empty early-morning platform at a small Tokyo suburban train station, Haru waits alone looking relieved; the train pulls in and Kana is sitting right behind the window. [4-7s] Inside a small city bus, Haru sits down and freezes: Kana is two seats ahead, the plain blue paperback held up close to her face. [7-10s] Inside the city bus, close-up of Kana's fingers holding the book open on the same page, not moving.

scenes.say: Three weeks of running. Twenty-one days, twenty-one meetings. Her number drops to eleven thousand nine hundred seventy-nine. Haru starts to wonder who meets anyone twelve thousand times.
scenes.video: [0-4s] On the same small Tokyo station platform, Haru arrives under an umbrella in the rain and Kana is already waiting there with her book. [4-7s] Inside the morning train car, close-up of the soft glowing number above Kana's head ticking down by one. [7-10s] In Haru's small bedroom in a Tokyo apartment at night, he sits at his desk with his chin in his hands, staring out the window.

scenes.say: So on day twenty-two, he sits right next to her and finally asks what she's reading. She lowers the book. Her face is bright red. She hasn't read a word.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Inside the morning train car, Haru takes a deep breath and sits down right next to Kana. [4-7s] On the same train seat, Haru turns to her and speaks; Kana slowly lowers the plain blue paperback. [7-10s] Inside the train car, close-up of Kana's face, cheeks bright red, eyes darting away.

scenes.say: Her name is Kana. She points above his head: 'Yours said twelve thousand too.' They both laugh. Eleven thousand nine hundred seventy-eight meetings left, and now they want every one.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Inside the morning train car, Kana shyly points above Haru's head and Haru looks up, startled. [4-7s] On the same train seat, Haru and Kana laugh side by side, warm morning sunlight through the train window. [7-10s] Wide shot down the quiet train car as it crosses a river bridge, Haru and Kana sitting together, two small soft glowing numbers above their heads.
